component.name: RevisarTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "revisar" end sub
function nuevo(url as string, port as object) as object t = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") t.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") t.InitClientCertificates() t.SetMessagePort(port) t.SetUrl(url) t.AddHeader("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Roku) TeleLibre") t.RetainBodyOnError(true) return t end function
function resolver(base as string, rel as string) as string rel = rel.Trim() if LCase(Left(rel, 7)) = "http://" or LCase(Left(rel, 8)) = "https://" then return rel p = Instr(1, base, "//") if Left(rel, 2) = "//" then return Left(base, p - 1) + rel q = Instr(1, base, "?") if q > 0 then base = Left(base, q - 1) if Left(rel, 1) = "/" r = Instr(p + 2, base, "/") if r = 0 then return base + rel return Left(base, r - 1) + rel end if i = Len(base) while i > 0 and Mid(base, i, 1) <> "/" i = i - 1 end while return Left(base, i) + rel end function
' Dirección final después de las redirecciones (para armar bien las direcciones relativas) function finalDe(url as string, ev as object) as string u = url hs = ev.GetResponseHeadersArray() if hs <> invalid for each h in hs for each k in h if LCase(k) = "location" then u = resolver(u, h[k]) end for end for end if return u end function
function primeraDireccion(txt as string, desde as string) as string if desde <> "" p = Instr(1, txt, desde) if p > 0 then txt = Mid(txt, p) end if for each l in txt.Split(Chr(10)) l = l.Trim() if l <> "" and Left(l, 1) <> "#" then return l end for return "" end function
sub revisar() urls = m.top.urls if urls = invalid then urls = [] port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") activos = {} malos = [] total = urls.Count() sig = 0 hechos = 0 reloj = CreateObject("roTimespan") while hechos < total while activos.Count() < 6 and sig < total if not pedir(urls[sig], urls[sig], 1, port, activos, reloj) hechos = hechos + 1 malos.Push(urls[sig]) end if sig = sig + 1 end while msg = wait(2000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" and msg.GetInt() = 1 id = msg.GetSourceIdentity().ToStr() a = activos[id] if a <> invalid activos.Delete(id) code = msg.GetResponseCode() txt = msg.GetString() listo = true bien = false if a.paso = 3 bien = (code = 200 or code = 206) else if (code = 200 or code = 206) and Instr(1, txt, "#EXTM3U") > 0 base = finalDe(a.url, msg) if a.paso = 1 and Instr(1, txt, "#EXT-X-STREAM-INF") > 0 v = primeraDireccion(txt, "#EXT-X-STREAM-INF") if v <> "" if pedir(a.canal, resolver(base, v), 2, port, activos, reloj) then listo = false end if else s = primeraDireccion(txt, "") if s <> "" if pedir(a.canal, resolver(base, s), 3, port, activos, reloj) then listo = false end if end if else if code = 200 and a.paso = 1 and LCase(Right(a.canal, 5)) <> ".m3u8" and Instr(1, a.canal, "jmp2.uk") = 0 bien = true ' no es una lista HLS: si responde, se da por buena end if if listo hechos = hechos + 1 if not bien then malos.Push(a.canal) end if end if end if ' Lo que tarde más de 20 segundos no respondió ahora = reloj.TotalMilliseconds() for each id in activos.Keys() a = activos[id] if ahora - a.inicio > 20000 a.t.AsyncCancel() activos.Delete(id) hechos = hechos + 1 malos.Push(a.canal) end if end for if hechos mod 25 = 0 and hechos > 0 then m.top.progreso = hechos.ToStr() + " de " + total.ToStr() end while m.top.malos = malos end sub
function pedir(canal as string, url as string, paso as integer, port as object, activos as object, reloj as object) as boolean t = nuevo(url, port) if paso = 3 then t.AddHeader("Range", "bytes=0-2047") if not t.AsyncGetToString() then return false activos[t.GetIdentity().ToStr()] = { t: t, canal: canal, url: url, paso: paso, inicio: reloj.TotalMilliseconds() } return true end function
